ceu: ✦ The sextile between Venus and Neptune

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.

The sextile between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, friendships and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
With Mars retrograde in your romance sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Say no to a task that is not yours.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.

The sextile between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, your career and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
With Mercury retrograde in your career sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Accept an invitation that is different from usual.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.

The sextile between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, your horizons and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
With Mars retrograde in your communication sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Speak frankly about a matter you keep avoiding.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.

The sextile between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
With Mercury retrograde in your intimacy sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Give way on something small to gain on something big.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.

The sextile between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, relationships and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
With Mars retrograde in your self-image sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Book that test or check-up you keep putting off.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.

The sextile between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, routine and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
With Mercury retrograde in your daily routine sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Allow yourself a sweet or a treat without guilt.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.

The sextile between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, romance and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
With Mars retrograde in your friendship sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Tidy a drawer or a corner of the house that bothers you.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.

The sextile between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, family and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. An idea from today could become a real project.
With Mercury retrograde in your home and family sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Take a different route on your usual way.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.

The sextile between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, conversations and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
With Mars retrograde in your horizons sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Treat yourself to a small comfort that costs almost nothing.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.

The sextile between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, money and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
With Mercury retrograde in your money sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Wear a colour you really love and notice how it changes your mood.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.

The sextile between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, your image and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
With Mars retrograde in your relationships sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Switch off your phone an hour before bed.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.

The sextile between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, your inner life and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
With Mercury retrograde in your inner life sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Introduce two people who could help each other.
